lines.text: Go on for a hundred! How many are multiples of three?

lines.text: How many of the first hundred are multiples of three? Here are the choices.

lines.text: Track the remainder after dividing by three: one, zero, zero, and repeat.
lines.caption: Track the remainder after dividing by three: one, zero, zero, and repeat.

lines.text: So every group of three spots holds exactly two multiples of three.
lines.caption: So every group of three spots holds exactly two multiples of three.

lines.text: One hundred spots is thirty-three groups, plus one extra spot.
lines.caption: One hundred spots is thirty-three groups, plus one extra spot.

lines.text: Thirty-three groups, two each. The extra spot leaves one, so it adds none.
lines.caption: Thirty-three groups, two each. The extra spot leaves one, so it adds none.

lines.text: Not thirty-three. Each group has TWO.
lines.caption: Not thirty-three. Each group has TWO.
